description: issue #679 (SP7): the declaration-slot rule covers struct CONSTRUCTORS as well as procedures, so with `sprites` active `struct tell`/`struct ask`/`struct each` each raise `ol-reserved-word` at the struct-name token. `struct` is one of the grammar's four declaration slots (spec/grammar.md:382), which is why this fixture is unaffected by maintainer ruling #833. Binding is free (`spec/grammar.md:386`) and is pinned by the sibling fixture reserved-bindings-with-sprites; this fixture owns the struct-constructor case, which is a declaration and collides. The sibling reserved-struct-without-sprites checks the same declarations with Sprites absent and expects the same diagnostics: `tell` is a built-in NAME whether or not its profile is claimed (`spec/grammar.md:408`). `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: the harness strips it from BOTH sides before comparing (`scripts/harness/index.mjs:977-983`), so supplying one here would be an assertion nothing can evaluate.
